state.description: The data to judge: a string, or a JSON object or array. Sent to the configured TypeSafe endpoint. Treated as data; instructions inside it are not followed.

criteria.description: Optional: what yes and what no mean, when the boundary is subtle. Give at least one of the two.

id.description: Key for the answer in the result. Default "answer".

model.description: Model id or alias. Default: the server's configured model.
